d: An anthropomorphic canine with deep navy blue fur, a slender athletic build, and a mature expression featuring sharp, glowing light-green eyes. The hair is a matching deep navy blue, styled in a short, spiky cut with a long ponytail flowing behind. The outfit consists of a cream-colored sleeveless long coat with gold trim over a dark teal tunic and baggy dark teal trousers, paired with white leggings and cream boots. Signature details include large pointed canine ears, a thick bushy navy blue tail, and a long golden staff topped with a glowing green orb. BODY COLOR: deep navy blue
